summary: VSOL V1600G0-B (READ-ONLY, GPON, SSH) integration verified end-to-end without touching real hardware. 12/12 pytest tests pass (adapter parsing via FakeTransport, credential-leak safety, catalog, device lifecycle graceful behaviour, provisioning refusal on VSOL, ZTE C320 regression). Frontend Add-OLT form correctly switches to SSH/port 22 with Enable Password visible when VSOL V1600G0-B is chosen; ZTE C320 still Telnet/port 23. OLT Detail page correctly HIDES Authorize button and Provisioning Log tab for VSOL, and still SHOWS them for ZTE. All test devices were cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: parse_running_config_safe uses a keyword deny-list ('password','shared-key','secret','psk','acs','key ') to skip credential lines — comprehensive for known VSOL running-config lines. Consider also blocking 'community' (SNMP) and 'wpa' variants as future OLT firmware may add them.

VsolV1600G0BAdapter.get_onu_running_config wraps commands with 'configure terminal' + 'interface gpon <port>' + 'end'. Ensure the SSH transport actually returns from config-mode cleanly; on a real box, an unexpected error mid-script may leave the CLI in config mode across sessions. Fine for now since each session logs in fresh.

olt_management._prov_result maps UNSUPPORTED->HTTP 400 with message 'Adapter ini belum mendukung provisioning'. This correctly refuses VSOL provisioning without duplicating capability checks in each endpoint.
seed_data_creation: All test OLTs (TEST_UI_VSOL, TEST_UI_ZTE, TEST_OLT_VSOL, TEST_OLT_ZTE_reg) are ephemeral and deleted at teardown of each test/fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for VSOL/ZTE: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_vsol_adapter.py` (12 tests, ~10s). Uses FakeTransport in-process for parsers; API tests exercise catalog, lifecycle POST/GET/DELETE, poll (graceful unreachable), provisioning refusal for VSOL, and a ZTE C320 dry-run authorize regression. No real OLT reachability needed.
